newsitem.title: USA: Staffmark Q1 shr $0.16 vs pro forma $0.06.
newsitem.headline: Staffmark Q1 shr $0.16 vs pro forma $0.06.

text.p: (a) 0perating results for the three months ended March 31,1996 will be reported to the SEC in accordance with the Provisions of the SEC Staff Accounting Bulletin No. 97. This pronouncement requires that one of the original Founding Companies be identified as the acquirer for financial reporting purposes.
Therefore, results reported for the three months ended March 31, 1996 will represent only the operations of the identified acquiring company rather than the combined operating results as shown above.

(b) Pro Forma net income and EPS reflect the financial results of the operations of the companies which merged effective with the IPO as if the companies had been members of the same operating group adjusted to reflect the effect of significant 1996 acquisitions, adjustments for corporate income taxes and reductions in owner's compensation as reflected in the Company's Form S-1 filed with the Securities Exchange Commission "SEC" on July 3, 1996. Pro forma results adjusted for the acquisition of Flexible for a full quarter, would have resulted in EPS of $0.17 and $0.05 for the three months ended March 31, 1997 and 1996, respectively.
